description.value: The South Cariboo Recreation Centre is a multi-sport facility anchored by an ice rink in 100 Mile House, operated by Canlan Ice Sports. It serves as a community hub in the South Cariboo region, offering a range of sport and recreation opportunities. For a touring cyclist passing through 100 Mile House, it represents the main indoor recreation facility in town.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content fetched from the District of 100 Mile House page is almost entirely navigation/menu boilerplate with no substantive body text describing the South Cariboo Recreation Centre's facilities or amenities. OSM tags confirm it is a multi-sport ice rink facility operated by Canlan Ice Sports. Without any descriptive content from the website, all amenity fields must remain null; the OSM operator tag (Canlan Ice Sports) and the municipal website host (District of 100 Mile House) suggest a possible management discrepancy worth flagging.
concerns: OSM operator tag lists 'Canlan Ice Sports' but the linked website is the District of 100 Mile House municipal site; it is unclear who currently manages the facility and whether contact details differ.
Website page for the rec centre returned no substantive body content — only site navigation — making amenity verification impossible from this source.
No phone number available in OSM or on the fetched page.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The facility is a legitimate multi-sport recreation centre and a plausible WWC stop, but the website content fetched was pure navigation boilerplate with no detail on amenities — none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water, washrooms) could be confirmed. A direct visit or phone inquiry is needed before a listing decision can be made.

wow_evidence: Ordinary Canlan-operated ice rink rec centre; rubric anchor for standard rec centre.
blurb: Ice-rink-anchored recreation centre in 100 Mile House.
